caption_L1: This line chart is labeled Bulgaria : Youth unemployment rate from 1999 to 2020. The y-axis plots Youth unemployment rate using linear scale with a minimum of 0.0 and a maximum of 0.4 while the x-axis plots Year on linear scale with a minimum of 2000 and a maximum of 2015.
caption_L2L3: The highest rate of youth unemployment is in approximately 2001 where the graph has its highest peak. It has a lower peak between 2010 and 2015. The highest rate is just below 0.4 and the lowest rate is below 0.1 which is in 2020. There is an overall downward trend in the youth unemployment rate but very distinct highs and lows in the total time period.
